subject: Confirmation of Flight Booking
body: Dear [Recipient], We are pleased to confirm the booking of your upcoming flight from New York to London on June 15th. Your flight details are as follows: - Departure: June 15th, 10:00 AM from JFK - Arrival: June 15th, 10:00 PM at LHR Please ensure you arrive at the airport at least 2 hours prior to departure. If you have any questions or need assistance, feel free to contact us. We look forward to welcoming you on board! Best regards, The Flight Booking Team
